description: Adds up to 1000 guests to the selected wedding in one call, from a pasted list, a spreadsheet or contact cards. Each guest needs a first name; last name, title, email, phone, postal address and a household label are optional, and guests sharing a household label reply together. Guests already on the list are skipped and named in the result rather than added twice. Results count who was added and how many came with an email, a phone number and an address. Guests under 13 are added in Aisle, not here; notes and dietary details are unsupported. Requires sign-in and an Aisle membership.

age_band.description: Explicit confirmation that no guest in this call is under 13, obtained before the list is sent.

guests.description: The guests to add, at most 1000.

address.description: Postal address, split into its parts.

household.description: Any label shared by guests who reply together, such as "Coquillette". Guests with the same label in this call become one household.

phone.description: Include + and the country code outside the United States.

title.description: Such as Dr., Mrs. or Mr.

wedding_id.description: Identifier of a wedding the signed-in account can manage. Required when the account has multiple weddings.

name: add_my_guests
title: Add Guests to My Wedding
